positions.title: Sr. Staff Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Developing flash management storage software for TLC NAND based SATA SSD
- Designed and developed features regarding data retention against read disturb of TLC NAND
- Filed U.S. patent regarding efficient management of FTL metadata for data retention features
- Improved reliability of data management algorithm for sudden power loss
- Performance bottleneck analysis with characterized workloads
- Failure analysis and stabilized storage software for OEM Qualification

positions.title: Sr. System Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Developed SpansionFFS (Flash Filesystem) for NAND/NOR flash memory
- Developed bad block management & wear-leveling algorithm for NAND/NOR flash memory
- Developed linux block device driver with MTD layer and Spansion Block Driver (FTL)
- Ported and integrated SpansionFFS(Flash Filesystem) on Qualcomm platforms
- Bring-up ARM SoCs and boards
